reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I reorder the brand I'm used to when it runs out. A sachet to carry around solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I already have a magnesium I'm loyal to, and I take it at home. I don't need a portable version, and I'd be paying for the convenience.
would_change_my_mind: If my current brand got more expensive or went out of stock, or if I started traveling a lot and needed something to carry.
